channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: সাড়ে ২৩ কেজির দুটি কোরাল মাছ ৩০ হাজার টাকায় বিক্রি
item.description: বাজারে প্রদর্শনের পর সাড়ে ২৩ কেজি ওজনের দুটি কোরাল মাছ ৩০ হাজার টাকায় বিক্রি করা হয়েছে। মাছটি দেখতে ও দাম জানতে উৎসুক মানুষের ভিড় জমেছিল।

item.title: মহানবমীর পূজায় শান্তি ও সম্প্রীতির প্রার্থনা
item.description: মহানবমীর পবিত্র তিথিতে দেবী দুর্গার পূজা করেন ভক্তরা। এ সময় অশুভ শক্তির বিনাশ ঘটিয়ে শুভশক্তির বিজয়ের প্রার্থনা করা হয়।

item.title: রাজশাহীতে পৌঁছে জনসভায় যোগ দিলেন প্রধানমন্ত্রী তারেক রহমান
item.description: প্রধানমন্ত্রী হিসেবে প্রথমবার রাজশাহী সফরে এসে পৌঁছেছেন তারেক রহমান। মঙ্গলবার বিকেল তিনটায় সামরিক বিমানে শাহ মখদুম বিমানবন্দরে নেমে তিনি জনসভায় যোগ দেন।

item.title: কম্যান্ডার্সকে হারিয়ে অপরাজিত ধারা ধরে রাখল ফোর্থিনাইনার্স
item.description: ওয়াশিংটন কম্যান্ডার্সকে ২৩-১৭ পয়েন্টে হারিয়েছে সান ফ্রান্সিসকো ফোর্থিনাইনার্স। এর মাধ্যমে এনএফএলে টানা ছয়টি জয় তুলে নিল দলটি।

item.title: বাজেটে ক্যাপিটাল গেইনস ট্যাক্স বাড়ানোর দাবি নাকচ চ্যান্সেলরের
item.description: লেবার পার্টির প্রভাবশালী মহলের দাবি সত্ত্বেও মূলধনী লাভ কর বাড়াতে রাজি হননি চ্যান্সেলর। সমালোচকদের মতে, কর বাড়ালে ধনী ব্যক্তিরা ব্রিটেন ছেড়ে চলে যেতে পারেন।

item.title: ভিক্টোরিয়া সিক্রেটের ফ্যান্টাসি ব্রা ও কাইলি জেনারকে নিয়ে আলোচনা
item.description: ভিক্টোরিয়া সিক্রেটের ৬১৮ কোটি টাকার ফ্যান্টাসি ব্রা এবং মডেল হিসেবে কাইলি জেনারকে নির্বাচন করা নিয়ে নানা আলোচনা চলছে। এই ব্রা পরাকে ফ্যাশন দুনিয়ায় বড় অর্জন বলে মনে করা হয়।

item.title: কসোভোয় ডিডিআর প্রক্রিয়া শুরু হয় কুমানোভা চুক্তি ও প্রস্তাবের মাধ্যমে
item.description: ১৯৯৯ সালের জুনে কুমানোভা চুক্তি এবং জাতিসংঘের নিরাপত্তা পরিষদের ১২৪৪ নম্বর প্রস্তাবের আওতায় কসোভোতে ডিডিআর প্রক্রিয়া কার্যকর করা হয়।

item.title: পঞ্চগড় বন্ধুসভার সাংগঠনিক সভা ও পরিচিতি পর্ব অনুষ্ঠিত
item.description: নতুন সদস্যদের স্বতঃস্ফূর্ত অংশগ্রহণে পঞ্চগড় বন্ধুসভার একটি সাংগঠনিক সভা অনুষ্ঠিত হয়েছে। আনন্দমুখর এই আয়োজনে পরিচিতি পর্বের পাশাপাশি গান, আবৃত্তি ও আলোচনা হয়।

item.title: Alberta voters turn down independence vote
item.description: A majority of participants in Canada's Alberta province voted against a proposed vote on seceding from the nation. The electorate effectively dismissed the idea of holding an independence referendum.

item.title: MTM Alumni Association holds inauguration event
item.description: The inaugural ceremony of the MTM Alumni Association took place last Saturday at the Westin Hotel in the capital. Prime Minister's Public Administration Advisor Md. Ismail Zabiullah attended as the chief guest.

item.title: Mohan Bhagwat claims malicious forces plot to split India
item.description: RSS leader Mohan Bhagwat stated that envious malevolent forces are scheming to fragment India, pointing to protesters on the streets as part of this conspiracy driven by jealousy over the nation's progress.

item.title: Development initiative scrapped after Tk 3b expenditure
item.description: A government initiative has been officially cancelled despite an expenditure of three billion taka. Authorities decided to abandon the undertaking following the massive financial cost.

item.title: IAF chief AP Singh completes final uniform flight in Kiran jet
item.description: Air Chief Marshal AP Singh finished his flying service by piloting a Kiran aircraft for his final sortie. He flew with his former instructor, Wing Commander V S Kochchar, at the Air Force Academy in Dundigal.

item.title: Indian bowlers dominate latest ICC T20I rankings update
item.description: Shree Charani and Deepti Sharma lead India's strong showing in the ICC Women's T20I Bowling Rankings. Meanwhile, teammates Nandani Sharma and Kranti Gaud also improved their positions as India secured a 2-0 series lead.

item.title: Project cancelled after 14 years and Tk 30b spent
item.description: A transport initiative was scrapped after enduring fourteen years of work and spending roughly Tk 28.11 billion. The dedicated buses were never deployed, leaving a 20-kilometre stretch with worse traffic and public hardship.

item.title: Egypt considers military support for Saudi Arabia amid Houthi conflict
item.description: Egypt is reviewing potential military assistance for Saudi Arabia as fighting with Yemen's Houthis intensifies. President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi plans to seek parliamentary approval for the deployment discussions.

item.title: Mumbai police outline traffic changes for Dussehra event
item.description: Authorities in Mumbai have shared detour plans and road blocks for the upcoming Shiv Sena UBT rally at Shivaji Park. The civic body approved the gathering under 24 specific rules, mandating noise limit adherence, a 10 p.m. finish, and site cleanup.

item.title: Jaishankar and UAE minister discuss trade and regional issues
item.description: India's External Affairs Minister met the UAE Foreign Minister in Mumbai to review bilateral ties. They noted that their trade pact has boosted economic cooperation, while also addressing the volatile security climate in West Asia.

item.title: Mitu Akter overcomes adversity to inspire others
item.description: Carrying a broken laptop and her infant, Mitu Akter rebuilt her life from scratch. She has not only transformed her own circumstances but now motivates ten other young individuals.

item.title: French PM notes quiet night following localized curfews
item.description: The French prime minister reported peaceful conditions overnight after implementing targeted curfews to curb recent unrest. Officials are considering additional curfews, while EU trade commissioner Maroš Šefčovič emphasized the critical ties between the bloc and the UK.

item.title: Walmart and Sam's Club introduce combined annual membership
item.description: Walmart has rolled out a $120 annual combined membership option covering both Walmart and Sam's Club. This move aims to boost customer convenience through expanded delivery options and fuel savings.

item.title: Seoul to reduce diplomatic personnel in Ukraine
item.description: South Korea plans to withdraw additional embassy personnel from Ukraine following a dispute over prisoners of war. This decision comes shortly after Seoul summoned its Kyiv ambassador home after President Zelenskyy revealed a prisoner transfer.

item.title: Medical advocates request essential status for communication tools
item.description: A collective for disabled doctors has petitioned the central government to categorize communication aids and prosthetics as essential items. They argue the current draft rules for disability rights misclassify these crucial products.

item.title: New antiviral medication offers hope against dengue fever
item.description: Dengue continues to cause annual fatalities and rising hospitalizations across Bangladesh, a grim reality the nation has faced for over ten years. With local drug development largely absent, finding effective treatments remains a pressing public health challenge.

item.title: Former Minister Krishnankutty Criticizes UDF Over Kerala Power Rates
item.description: Ex-Minister K. Krishnankutty blamed the UDF administration's poor handling for the recent electricity price increase in Kerala. He also demanded clarity regarding how these financial deficits are computed.

item.title: Canadian Opera Company Drops Performer Over Palestinian Flag Display
item.description: A Calgary opera venue dropped a vocalist from upcoming shows following an incident where he displayed a Palestinian flag while on stage.

item.title: Kerala Environmentalists Oppose River Sand Mining Decision
item.description: The Society for the Protection of the Environment, Kerala, has criticized the state's plan to allow sand removal across 17 rivers. Activists noted that despite being framed as flood prevention, the initiative lacks an environmental impact assessment.

item.title: Ex-Pilot Gives $400,000 to Preserve Neil Armstrong's Childhood House
item.description: Retired pilot Ken Schreiber contributed $400,000 to help the Auglaize County Historical Society acquire and restore Neil Armstrong's boyhood residence to its 1940s condition.

item.title: ক্যানসারের সঙ্গে লড়ছেন সামিয়া, পাশে পরিবার
item.description: ২০২২ সালে কোলন ক্যানসারে আক্রান্ত হয়ে সিঙ্গাপুরে চিকিৎসা নেন সামিয়া। পরে শারীরিক অবস্থার উন্নতি হলে নিয়মিত ফলোআপের অংশ হিসেবে স্বামী ও সন্তান সংহতি প্রকাশ করে মাথা ন্যাড়া করেন।

item.title: ইউরোপের বিভিন্ন দেশে সাধারণ মানুষের বিক্ষোভ
item.description: স্পেন, ফ্রান্স ও পর্তুগালসহ ইউরোপীয় দেশগুলোতে বিভিন্ন বিষয়ে সাধারণ মানুষ ও তরুণেরা রাস্তায় নেমে বিক্ষোভ করেছেন। জীবনযাত্রার মান ও নানা দাবিতে এই অসন্তোষ ছড়িয়ে পড়েছে।

item.title: Ukrainian Drone Evacuates Frontline Soldier for the First Time
item.description: In a frontline first, Ukrainian forces utilized a heavy-lift hexacopter together with Gurzuf Defence to lift and transport an injured soldier away from a dangerous combat zone.

item.title: Trump White House Comment on Melania Sparks Laughter
item.description: A remark by Trump concerning Melania's signature elicited uncomfortable laughter during an event at the White House.

item.title: Autumn Rural Scenery Captured in Sylhet
item.description: Images captured in Islampur, Sylhet, on October 19, 2026, depict early morning countryside scenes in late autumn. The visual collection features agricultural workers tending damp fields along with close-up shots of moisture resting on harvested rice stalks and spider webs.

item.title: Katie Boulter Secures Japan Open Opening-Round Victory
item.description: British tennis player Katie Boulter defeated Himeno Sakatsume in her opening contest at the Japan Open. The fixture experienced weather delays due to rain before the match concluded with a decisive outcome for Boulter.

item.title: কম্বোডিয়া থেকে ৩০ বাংলাদেশি দেশে ফিরেছেন
item.description: কম্বোডিয়ার অভিবাসন বন্দীশিবিরে নিবন্ধিত ত্রিশ জন নাগরিক মঙ্গলবার দেশে প্রত্যাবর্তন করেছেন। উচ্চ বেতনের আশ্বাস দিয়ে সাইবার অপরাধে নিয়োজিত সংস্থায় বাধ্য করার পর তারা সেখান থেকে আত্মগোপন করেছিলেন বলে জানা গেছে।

item.title: Unemployment Drops While Smaller Businesses Reduce Recruitment
item.description: Data from the Office for National Statistics indicates a decline in the overall unemployment figure. However, smaller enterprises are slowing down recruitment efforts, attributing this reduction primarily to rising staffing expenses.

item.title: Delhi Dussehra Event to Feature Burning of Cockroach Effigy
item.description: Organizers in Delhi plan to burn a 30-foot cockroach figure alongside Ravana during Dussehra festivities. The action is regarded as a symbolic response targeting CJP demonstrations related to claimed SIR irregularities.

item.title: Orionid Meteor Shower to Reach Peak Activity This Week
item.description: Stargazers can observe debris originating from Halley's Comet during the Orionid meteor display. The astronomical event will hit its highest intensity through the night spanning October 21 to October 22.

item.title: Sikkim Scheduled to Host Adventure Tourism Festival in November
item.description: The state of Sikkim will stage an adventure tourism festival in early November. The celebration is set to run from November 1 through November 7.

item.title: Google Cloud Outage Disrupts Revolut as British Pound Rallies
item.description: A technical breakdown at Google Cloud led to operational issues for banking app Revolut, affecting users. Meanwhile, the British pound strengthened to $1.3352 following an unanticipated drop in the UK jobless rate to 4.7 percent.

item.title: President accepts resignation of state minister Ishraque Hossain
item.description: The Cabinet Division published a gazette on Tuesday confirming the President approved Ishraque Hossain's departure from his post. Hossain had publicly declared his resignation on Monday afternoon.

item.title: Arrest made following historic Limoges town hall arson attack
item.description: French media report that a suspect was detained after Saturday's riots caused a fire at the Limoges city hall. The blaze led to the dramatic collapse of the clock tower's spire.

item.title: Fatal car crash damages Nagole water pipeline, supply restored
item.description: A vehicle collision near Nagole Metro Station ruptured a water line on Saturday, sending a jet 20 feet into the air and flooding nearby streets. Utility crews repaired the broken valve, resuming service after five hours.

item.title: Michigan couple spends seven weeks moving 116-year-old fridge
item.description: A pair from Michigan purchased a century-old refrigerator for nearly $5,000 online. Transporting the 1,000-pound appliance into their home demanded specialized movers and seven weeks of planning.

item.title: Marco Rubio arrives in Mumbai for meetings with Jaishankar
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio arrived in Mumbai and toured the Gateway of India alongside his spouse and Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis. He is scheduled to hold talks with S Jaishankar.

item.title: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio begins three-day India trip
item.description: Marco Rubio touched down in Mumbai on Tuesday for a three-day official visit. His itinerary features talks with external affairs minister S Jaishankar to strengthen bilateral ties, alongside a trip to Jamnagar.

item.title: RBI actions bolster rupee, analysts weigh short and long-term impacts
item.description: Recent central bank interventions have supported the rupee's currency value. Financial analysts advise investors against making hasty portfolio shifts based on these brief market fluctuations.

item.title: Scrap dealer's $14,000 golden egg identified as rare Fabergé piece
item.description: A scrap merchant who originally bought a golden egg for $14,000 later discovered it was a genuine Fabergé creation. The rare artifact was subsequently valued at an estimated $33 million.

item.title: France sees peaceful start to localized curfews
item.description: Following recent violent protests, the initial night of targeted curfews in France concluded without trouble. Prime Minister Sébastien indicated that additional restrictions might be applied on Tuesday if required.

item.title: Dead body recovered beneath Rampura bridge in Dhaka
item.description: Police recovered an unidentified man's body from under the Rampura bridge in the capital on Tuesday morning. Rampura police station officer-in-charge Jahangir Hossain confirmed the recovery.

item.title: England rugby league ready for France with same squad
item.description: Brad O'Neill rejected claims that England lacked preparation for the Rugby League World Cup. The team plans to use an unaltered lineup against France to turn their tournament around.

item.title: Kharge to discuss delimitation and SIR issues with PM
item.description: Opposition leader Kharge is scheduled to meet Prime Minister Narendra Modi to bring up matters regarding delimitation and SIR. The discussions are planned for the following day.

item.title: Pakistani businessman found dead in South Banasree
item.description: Law enforcement recovered the hanging body of 26-year-old Pakistani national Mohammad Shahbaz from a residence in South Banasree, Dhaka. The deceased worked as a businessman.

item.title: Arshad Warsi to star in Umesh Shukla's Jolly LLB prequel
item.description: Actor Arshad Warsi will reprise his role as lawyer Jagdish Tyagi for 'Jolly LLB 4', a prequel helmed by director Umesh Shukla. Production is underway and projected to conclude by January 2027.

item.title: Ishrak's resignation stands out among past ministerial exits
item.description: While roughly three dozen ministers have resigned since independence, Ishrak's departure is unique due to its connection to his participation in an armed operation.

item.title: First European Bee-eater documented at Broken Bridge
item.description: Birdwatchers have recorded the initial sighting of a European Bee-eater in Chennai. The observation took place at the Broken Bridge location.

item.title: Kerala HC: Supreme Court elephant registration deadline cannot be extended
item.description: Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas stated that neither the High Court nor the state government can alter the cutoff date set by the Supreme Court. The ruling came while addressing requests for delayed elephant registration and time extensions.

item.title: Former CIA Director Petraeus to speak on AI warfare at NDTV summit
item.description: General Petraeus, who served as CIA Director following a unanimous Senate vote after retiring from the military in August 2011, will address the NDTV World Summit regarding conflicts in the age of artificial intelligence.

item.title: French merchants seek insurance payouts following weekend looting
item.description: Store proprietors across France are submitting insurance claims for property damage after a weekend marked by widespread looting. Meanwhile, the government is formulating assistance programs to support affected businesses.

item.title: Victorian man charged with assaulting federal MP Helen Haines
item.description: Victorian authorities apprehended 43-year-old Tarrawingee resident Brendan Nugent on Monday following an alleged assault against parliament member Helen Haines in Wangaratta. He now faces three criminal charges in connection with the incident.
